## How it was tested

- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests (real PostgreSQL)
- [ ] End-to-end tests, if it changes something a person sees
- [ ] Checked by hand, if it changes something a person sees

## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat(core): ...`)
- [ ] Every new action has a permission, a risk level and tests for denied and invalid calls
- [ ] New fields have a privacy class
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] A changeset is added if a published package changes (`pnpm changeset`)
